usage: The word 公園 (gung1 jyun4) is a noun that means 'park,' a public outdoor space.
公園 can be used as the place where people go for walks, exercise, or relax.
You can combine 公園 with verbs like '去 (heoi3)' to say 'go to the park.'
It is common to use 公園 in directions when telling someone where to meet or hang out.
In questions, you can ask '去邊度公園? (heoi3 bin1 dou6 gung1 jyun4?)' to inquire about which park.
